chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Al-Nawfali, from Al-Sakuni, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: 'Perform the obligations of Allah, and you will become the most pious of people.'
ai.seo_question: What is the result of performing the obligations of Allah according to the Prophet?
ai.summary: Recorded in al-Kafi by Shaykh al-Kulayni, this hadith from Imam al-Sadiq (AS) underscores the foundational Shia principle that external compliance with divine commands (fara'id) is the primary vehicle for cultivating internal God-consciousness (taqwa). It highlights the inseparable link between ritual observance and spiritual refinement, serving as a cornerstone for understanding how legal obligations purify the soul.

en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Al Nowfaly, from Al Sakuny, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘(Through) performing the Obligations of Allah<sup>azwj</sup>, you would become the most pious of the people’.
en.sarwar: 4. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from al-Nawfali from al-Sakuni from abu ‘Abd Allah (a.s.) who has said the following: “
The Messenger of Allah has said, ‘Fulfill what Allah has made obligatory upon you. You will then be considered the most pious of the people.’”
